description: Verifies that a UI is fluid, not just functional: frame, interaction and layout-shift invariants, algorithmic layout checks across derived widths and font scales, honest limits of headless emulation, and gates that tell regressions from noise.

tools.name: breakpoints
tools.description: Derives the viewport test matrix (both sides of every media threshold, per user font scale) and the container sizes from CSS files.

tools.name: gate
tools.description: Three-valued UI quality gate: structural metrics compared exactly, timing samples by paired rank tests, bootstrap bounds and false-discovery control.

tools.name: layout_diff
tools.description: Structural layout regression between two probe snapshots, reduced to change clusters with their probable origins.
